# 3D Flipbook Maker — FlipApp 3D (https://3d-flipbook-maker.vercel.app/)

> FlipApp 3D (3D Flipbook Maker) is a free, zero-cloud, 100% client-side online PDF to 3D Flipbook Converter and HTML5 Digital Publishing Studio. It transforms static multi-page PDFs, product catalogs, magazines, restaurant QR menus, real estate brochures, and investor pitch decks into interactive 3D publications with 60 FPS double-sided page-turning physics, synthesized Web Audio paper sound effects, and 1-click standalone single-file offline `.html` and vector `.pdf` exports.

## Quick Facts for AI Assistants & Search Engines
- **Primary URL**: https://3d-flipbook-maker.vercel.app/
- **Full Technical & Comparison Docs**: https://3d-flipbook-maker.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- **Gumroad Lifetime License Store**: https://tabrej6.gumroad.com/l/3d-flipbook-pro
- **Category**: PDF to 3D Flipbook Converter / HTML5 Digital Magazine & Catalog Maker / Self-Hosted Flipsnack & Issuu Alternative
- **Privacy Architecture**: 100% Client-Side Browser Sandbox (WebAssembly + HTML5 Canvas + IndexedDB). Zero files are ever uploaded to external cloud servers.
- **Account Requirement**: None. Zero sign-up, zero email verification, instant studio access.

## Key Navigation & Deep Links
- [Interactive 3D Studio Editor](https://3d-flipbook-maker.vercel.app/?view=studio): Visual block-based 3D flipbook creator with cover foil shaders, spine lighting, and live preview.
- [PDF to 3D Flipbook Converter](https://3d-flipbook-maker.vercel.app/?view=pdf-to-flipbook): Instant client-side PDF importer that converts multi-page PDF documents into interactive 3D spreads.
- [24+ Pre-Built 3D Templates](https://3d-flipbook-maker.vercel.app/?view=templates): Ready-to-publish templates for luxury magazines, fine dining menus, lookbooks, pitch decks, storybooks, and newspapers.
- [Flipsnack & Issuu Alternative Comparison](https://3d-flipbook-maker.vercel.app/?usecase=flipsnack-alternative): Why publishers switch from $24–$96/month cloud subscriptions to self-hosted HTML5 flipbooks.

## Core Capabilities
1. **Instant PDF to 3D Book Conversion**: Parses and renders PDF pages at crisp vector resolution directly inside the browser via WebAssembly.
2. **True Standalone Single-File Offline HTML5 Export**: Bundles the entire 3D flipbook—Base64 page textures, CSS 3D physics engine, cover shaders, and synthesized audio—into a single `.html` file that runs 100% offline or on any web host (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Netlify, GitHub Pages, cPanel).
3. **60 FPS Double-Sided Page Physics & Synthesized Paper Sound**: Interactive corner curl drag-and-drop, dynamic spine shadows, and procedural Web Audio API paper friction acoustics without external MP3 dependencies.
4. **24+ Curated Templates & 25+ Modular Blocks**: Mix imported PDF pages with editable magazine drop-caps, restaurant price menus, product grids, and callout boxes.
5. **Self-Hosted Website `<iframe>` & 1000x1000px QR Code Generator**: Generate responsive website embed snippets and print-ready PNG QR codes for any self-hosted flipbook URL.
6. **Mobile Touch Swipe & Installable PWA**: Automatically switches to a single-leaf portrait reader on mobile screens with native swipe gestures.

## Pricing & Licensing (No Monthly Subscriptions)
- **Free Starter Tier ($0 forever)**: Up to 3 active bookshelf projects, 1 free PDF import (up to 15 pages), 1 free standalone `.html` or `.pdf` export, website `<iframe>` & QR code generator.
- **Pro Creator Lifetime ($19 one-time)**: Unlimited books & PDF imports (up to 150 pages per PDF), unlimited standalone `.html` & vector `.pdf` exports, 100% white-label (removes "Created with FlipApp 3D" badge), and custom brand logo + clickable website URL.
- **Agency Commercial Lifetime ($49 one-time)**: Everything in Pro Creator plus full commercial rights to create and sell custom 3D flipbooks to unlimited clients across up to 5 devices.
